text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
When I walk into the cafeteria, I spot
Sakura
Chiyono O eating a manju.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Hi, Trainer! Would you like a manju?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
They turned out really well today! I
came across a
video of how a
professional boils the red beans
and
tried my best to copy the method!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
It's amazing how delicious they came out
after
tweaking the cooking process a
little.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I love making desserts, so when I find an
area I
need to improve, my motivation
skyrockets! Of
course, the same goes for
training.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I'm planning to make even more manju
tomorrow,
so I bought a lot of red beans!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Oh... That's a good point. I almost got
carried
away there.
choice_data_list: Be careful not to overeat, okay?
Let's make and eat a lot so we can improve!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I know! I can just share the manju I make
with my
class and dormmates!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Hehe. I hope they'll like them.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The next day, everyone thanks Sakura
Chiyono O
for her manju, making her
grin with pride the
whole day.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
You're right! The more I make, the more
I'll
improve! I'm going to make and eat
loads of
manju!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Japanese desserts tend to contain less
fat
compared to Western desserts, so I
don't have to
worry as much while eating
them!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I'm so glad I'm a fan of Japanese
desserts! All
right, I'm going to eat to my
heart's content
tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The next day, Sakura Chiyono O joyfully
chows
down on a great deal of Japanese
desserts.
